title: December, 2015
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Does Chloe come home. She comes to the garage with a bottle and no Julian and sits on the floor where the table used to be low.

panels.composition: The garage door. CHLOE, thirty-five, in the gray cashmere, a bottle of something in a paper bag. No Julian. BARNABY II losing his mind at her ankles. WOOD at the table.

characters.pose: in the doorway with a bottle

balloons.text: Married a year and a half. He's with his family. I said I had a thing.

image.prompt: a woman in gray cashmere standing in a garage doorway holding a bottle in a paper bag, a three-legged dog dancing at her ankles, a thin man at a drafting table, razor-sharp ink

panels.composition: The two of them on the floor, backs to the banker's boxes. The pup between. The old bed, still under the table, empty. Chloe looking at it.

characters.pose: on the floor, looking at the old bed

balloons.text: I didn't ask if he used it.

image.prompt: a woman and a man sitting on a garage floor with their backs to banker's boxes, a three-legged dog between them, the woman looking at an empty braided dog bed under the table

panels.composition: Chloe's hand on the pup. Wood's hand on the pup. Not touching. The strip's third time.

image.prompt: close-up of two hands resting on a wiry three-legged dog, not touching each other, lamp light, no words

panels.composition: The garage from the door. Two people, a pup, a bottle, the lamp. The empty bed. 'Lanes' on the wall. The invitation, framed, beside it. She doesn't look at that one.

image.prompt: a garage studio from the doorway at night with a woman and a man on the floor and a small dog, a lamp, a framed watercolor and a framed wedding invitation on the wall, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: She comes home. To the garage, alone. 'I didn't ask if he used it.'
